headline: Enemy behaviour round 2. An enemy that wants you can reach you: closest approach to a walking player 8.14 m -> 1.61 m, 0 -> 294 frames inside its own strike band. RECOVER implemented (dwell 0.0414 -> 0.2521, the critic's predicted number). Seven fighting statblocks, seven distinct behaviours, from four (four of them bit-identical). 60 of 99 leaves have a demonstrated consumer.
next_step: none — hand to a critic. corpus/90-verdicts/wave1/W1-12-r1.md is the spec this answers.

results.closure_rule: gate on TARGET RECESSION, not on distance and not on closure. inf_trash vs a walking player: min gap 9.11 -> 1.61 m, frames inside strike 0 -> 294, RUSH frames 35 -> 385, same tree same process one leaf apart.
results.rule_8: 196 runs: 7 statblocks x 7 player behaviours (stand/walk/jog/sprint/strafe/circle/back away) x 4 ranges x 1800 f@60, every number reported at f 300/600/1200/1800. 58 of 84 fleeing rows reach the strike band; round 1 reached it in none.
results.variety: distinct behaviour signatures over the 7 fighting statblocks: 4 -> 7. The bit-identical group (sha1 1edb362ea24dde99) is gone. AI states reachable 9 -> 11 of 17.
results.recover: T15 implemented. min_dist_dwell 0.0414 -> 0.2521 on the round-1 fixture and seed; deleting it returns 0.0414 exactly. RI-AI01 M3 2/2 -> 1/2, not tuned back.
results.dead_parameters: 19 leaves removed or moved out of the game data (12 cone_deg, 3 duplicated perception constants, 1 probe threshold, 3 replaced); 10 leaves and 2 archetype columns wired; 1 wired-but-unselected and declared.
results.consumption: 99 leaves, 60 with a demonstrated world-side consumer over 6 census fixtures + 6 purpose-built rescue fixtures with two-sided perturbation, 20 declared-unrealised archetype rows, 19 unconsumed of which 14 are declared statblock-shadowed. Both controls behave; the tool exits non-zero if either does not.
results.s22: ruled RI-AI01's bare `f` is f@60 from three of the item's own seconds/frame pairs (720f=12.0s, 90f=1.5s, 36f=0.6s) against one contrary pair; reversible, filed against the corpus. units block + tools/combat/check-ai-units.mjs with a self-test.
results.delete_the_fix: six arms, reports/w1-12-r2/teardown.json. Every control moved. The delete-the-behaviour arm still collapses every enemy to a turning statue (0 moving frames, 0 commits, one state).
defects_found_in_my_own_work: an inert fix that IMPROVED the headline while breaking M3 (rule 6 third shape): the recession window spanned frames the AI is not stepped; two statblocks went over the 0.35 chase-bot HARD FAIL while the headline looked better
